feature: recursive gRPC load-balancing policy ownership and hierarchical endpoint paths

scope.service_config: arena-owned recursive tree for every currently implemented leaf and outlier wrapper
scope.compatibility: existing flat LoadBalancingConfig view and runtime selection remain unchanged
scope.endpoint_metadata: bounded borrowed hierarchical path on every endpoint variant
scope.resolution: ordinary Channel and SharedChannel preserve the complete path across hostname-to-address replacement

observed_contract: each composite policy consumes the first hierarchical path element and delegates the suffix
addresses without a path or with an empty path are excluded from hierarchical children
weighted_target childPolicy is recursively parsed through the global LB policy registry
weighted_target aggregates child connectivity and chooses only READY children by configured weight
removed weighted_target children are retained for delayed reuse

implementation.tree: LoadBalancingNode stores pick_first, round_robin, least_request, ring_hash, weighted_round_robin, and outlier_detection child ownership
implementation.flat_view: LoadBalancingConfig continues to expose the selected leaf policy and configuration used by existing Channel implementations
implementation.ownership: all nodes and parsed strings live in the ServiceConfig arena; deinit releases them transactionally
implementation.inspection: LoadBalancingNode.leafPolicy walks wrappers without flattening away their structure
implementation.path: Endpoint hierarchical_path is borrowed for the Channel lifetime, capped at 32 levels, and rejects empty elements
implementation.ordinary_resolution: HostResolution carries hierarchical_path into generated cleartext_ip and tls_address endpoints
implementation.shared_resolution: SharedChannel Source carries hierarchical_path into every physical worker target
implementation.identity: origin authority, TLS identity, proxy routing, ring-hash key/weight, and all existing picker semantics remain unchanged

negative_boundary.reason: parsing a policy name before both Channel owners execute arbitrary recursive childPolicy would be false parity
negative_boundary.next_required_work: recursive ordinary and SharedChannel runtime nodes with child connectivity aggregation, READY-only weighted selection, suffix consumption, and delayed child retention

tests: outlier_detection tree owns and exposes its round_robin child
outlier_detection tree owns a configured least_request child after the input JSON is overwritten and freed
allocation-failure sweep includes wrapper and child node allocation
unconfigured service config has a null policy root
unknown-policy fallback still selects the first implemented leaf
ordinary host resolution preserves a two-element hierarchical path
SharedChannel source resolution preserves the same path shape
empty path elements and paths deeper than 32 are rejected
verification_commands: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='gRPC service config owns parsed selectors' --summary all
remaining_gap: weighted_target_experimental remains intentionally unsupported until the retained tree drives both runtime owners
